topic: Production database update and time zone sync
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating the production environment, specifically regarding the ClickHouse instance. It was noted that a time zone fix (Kyiv) had been implemented on the sandbox environment and needs to be pushed to production.

One participant confirmed having already deployed the time zone update to production. Another participant suggested that a full restart might not be necessary for ClickHouse to recognize the changes, as the issue may relate to using an outdated version of the database on the live environment compared to the sandbox.
decisions: The need to update the production ClickHouse instance and synchronize the correct time zone settings was identified.
